svg.title: PNEUMA pipeline metro map
svg.desc: Metro-map overview of the PNEUMA pipeline as eight labelled stage blocks: Input, QC and host removal, Taxonomic classification, Abundance estimation, Contamination assessment, Functional profiling, Downstream analysis (MERIDIAN) and the planned Phase 2 Metagenome reconstruction.

text.tspan: PNEUMA: ONT metagenomics for low-biomass respiratory samples
one row per sample x run
